learn.title: Repeated multiplying
learn.body: An exponential function has the form $y=a\cdot b^x$. The starting value is $a$ (the value at $x=0$) and each step multiplies by the base $b$. If $b>1$ it is growth. If $b$ is between 0 and 1 it is decay.

learn.title: Doubling population
learn.body: A colony starts at 200 and doubles every hour.

learn.title: Percent change
learn.body: For a growth rate $r$ the base is $b=1+r$. Growing 5% a year gives $b=1.05$. A decay of 12% gives $b=1-0.12=0.88$. Starting at 1000 and growing 5% for 10 years gives $1000\cdot 1.05^{10}\approx 1628.89$.
A half-life is a decay with $b=\frac{1}{2}$ per period. After 3 half-lives only $\frac{1}{8}$ is left.

questions.prompt: A colony is $200\cdot 2^t$. How many after $t=3$ hours?

questions.explanation: The base 0.9 is between 0 and 1, so each step multiplies by less than 1.

questions.prompt: What base $b$ models 8% growth per year?
What base models 12% decay per year?
80 mg of a drug has a half-life of 1 hour. How many mg remain after 3 hours?
1000 grows 5% per year for 10 years. Give the result rounded to 2 decimals.
What is the value of $y=3\cdot 2^x$ at $x=0$?
questions.explanation: $2^0=1$, so $y=3$. The value at $x=0$ is always $a$.
A base above 1 makes the values rise at every step.
